subject: Crescent AI — demo request paused due to roadmap reprioritization
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@crescent.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@crescent.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + demo request (Crescent AI)

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for the outreach — Crescent is still very interested in seeing Redwood's inference stack, especially around predictable latency for our customer-facing features. We have two folks who should join the call: Tom (Head of Platform) and I.

Are you available for a 45min demo the week of May 24? Ideally an early slot in the West Coast morning. If you can send a brief agenda, I'll confirm with Tom and our PM.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Park
Director of Platform
Crescent AI

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@crescent.ai>
Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@crescent.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + demo request (Crescent AI)
Attachments: Redwood_Demo_Agenda.pdf

Hi Elena — great to hear. 45 minutes works. Proposed slots:
- Tue May 25, 9:00–9:45 PT
- Wed May 26, 9:30–10:15 PT
- Thu May 27, 8:30–9:15 PT

Attached is a short agenda (high-level architecture, latency/cost tradeoffs, live inference demo, next steps). Marissa from Solutions will join to cover architecture and pilot sizing.

If none of those work, tell me two windows that do and we'll adapt.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Park <elena.park@crescent.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@crescent.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + demo request (Crescent AI)
Attachments: Crescent_Roadmap_Snapshot.pdf

Rafael — quick update: we've had an all-hands and the product org decided to push major infra/observability work into the next two quarters. That means the LLM inference evaluation is being deprioritized for now; resources are being reallocated to the observability sprint. Also, Tom will be traveling to EMEA the week of the demo windows you sent.

Can we pause scheduling for now? I'll share a one-page snapshot of our roadmap so you have context (attached). We'll likely revisit this in Q4 once the observability work is complete.

Apologies for the churn — we still want to evaluate Redwood, just not on the current timeline. Can you put us on a 3-month check-in cadence?

Thanks,
Elena

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@crescent.ai>
Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@crescent.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + demo request (Crescent AI)

Thanks for the context, Elena — totally understood. Two quick asks: (1) would you like us to hold a placeholder check-in the first week of September (we can swap the calendar invite if plans change), and (2) would it help if we shared a tailored one-pager on Redwood's low-effort pilot that minimizes engineering lift during an observability sprint?

We can also put Crescent on our pilot waitlist and offer a small credits package for when you’re ready to run the POC — happy to coordinate with our customer success team.

I’ll mark the demo as deferred on our side and follow up for a September check-in unless you prefer a different cadence.

Best,
Rafael

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Intro + demo request (Crescent AI) — prospect deprioritized

Forwarding Crescent's note — product pulled their LLM evaluation into the backlog while they prioritize observability work and travel. Tom's travel window and the org decision mean we should not force the demo now.

Suggested next steps:
- Offer a short "low-effort pilot" one-pager and a small credit package to keep momentum (Priyom, can CS prepare an offer template?)
- Add Crescent to the Q3 nurture list with a September check-in (Marissa, can you create a HubSpot task and set a reminder for 2027-09-01?)
- Mark the opportunity as "deferred" in the CRM with deal_id CRS-2027-0412 and set a 90d follow-up.

Thoughts?

-Rafael

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Intro + demo request (Crescent AI) — prospect deprioritized

Thanks Rafael — plan sounds good. I will:
- Draft the one-pager focused on a zero-lift pilot (config + default prompts + sample evals).
- Ask CS (Priyom) to propose a 500 USD credit package and a lightweight onboarding checklist.
- Create the HubSpot task and set the check-in for 2027-09-01; I'll bcc the Crescent contact so they get the placeholder invite.

We should not escalate credits without the SDR/AE consensus — small, time-bound credits only. I’ll update the deal stage to "deferred" and add the roadmap snapshot to the record.

-Marissa
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
